critical_evidence.evidence: The listing contains no borescope images, no specialist inspection and no engine rebuild or re-sleeve record for this 3.4 M97. The profile marks this as a hard requirement for a Cayman S.
No DME over-rev report is provided or mentioned. It matters on a four-owner manual car.
No cooling-system, water-pump, coolant-pipe, AOS or major-service documentation is mentioned. At 19 years old with low annual mileage, this age-related work is unaddressed on the evidence available.

documentation.rationale: The identity half is present: VIN matching the decode, an AutoCheck summary (clean title, 0 accidents reported, 4 owners) and a full factory equipment list. The maintenance half is absent: no service invoices, no borescope, no DME report, and no photos of at-risk areas (underside, cooling, engine). 'Price includes fees' is not itemised.

condition.rationale: Nothing wrong is stated, and the studio photos show a clean exterior and interior with only light seat creasing. Mechanical condition is entirely unproven, including cylinder walls, cooling, AOS, clutch and tire dates. Low mileage is not evidence of condition on a 19-year-old car.

price_value.rationale: The asking price of $41,593 sits above the fair-value estimate of $30,190–$37,230 (mid $31,421). Comparable sales include a 28k-mile 2007 S at $27,500 and a 38k-mile 2008 S at $34,250. CarGurus' 'Great Deal' label is its own model, not evidence. The low-mileage premium is unsupported without a borescope or records.

mission_fit.rationale: A manual 987 Cayman S belongs in the future-keeper category. However, the profile accepts the 3.4 S only with unusually strong engine diligence, none of which is present. The price is far from the ideal $10,000–$19,000 band and cuts against cash preservation in accelerated_bridge mode.

logistics.rationale: Wichita, KS is a long fly-and-drive from Carmel. A franchised Porsche dealer makes paperwork and an inspection plausible, but independent PPI or borescope access is not stated. CA smog and emissions certification need confirming for an out-of-state car.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: It is a 6-speed manual S in Meteor Gray with full Sand Beige leather, a genuinely desirable and coherent factory spec, and it appears stock. The options are otherwise thin, with no Sport Chrono or PASM listed.

ppi_focus: Borescope of all six cylinders, especially 4-6, looking for scoring or skirt wear. Retain the images.
DME over-rev report (ranges 1-6) and engine hours versus mileage.
Compression and leakdown, interpreted alongside the borescope and not instead of it.
Oil filter inspection for metal or plastic debris; consider oil analysis for IMS-era and bore-wear markers.
Cooling system: water pump weep, coolant pipe and crossover condition, front radiators and debris, reservoir cracks.
AOS health: crankcase vacuum, oil smoke on cold start, oil in the intake.
Rear main seal and IMS-area weeping at the bellhousing.
Clutch slip, engagement height and dual-mass flywheel noise.
Tire date codes, bushings and control arms after long periods of low use; alignment wear pattern.
Underside and paint meter for unreported repairs (a clean AutoCheck is not proof), plus a CA smog pre-check.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a clean independent borescope with photos of all six cylinders plus a clean DME over-rev report.
Up: invoices for water pump, coolant pipes, AOS and recent fluids, plus tires with recent date codes.
Up: a negotiated price materially closer to the $30,190–$37,230 fair-value range.
Down: any cylinder scoring, range 1-2 over-revs, a coolant or IMS/RMS leak, or dealer refusal of an independent PPI or borescope before money moves.
evidence.mission_note: A manual Cayman S is a future-keeper candidate, not a bridge car. At this asking price and with no engine diligence, its appeal is purely as a keeper, and it conflicts with the cash-preservation posture of accelerated_bridge mode.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity well: the VIN decodes to a 2007 Cayman S 3.4 coupe, a manual is confirmed in the photos, and the Meteor Gray over full Sand Beige leather spec appears stock. An AutoCheck summary reports a clean title, 0 accidents and 4 previous owners. Nothing mechanically wrong is observed or disclosed, and the studio photos show a clean, lightly worn car. What is missing is the entire engine and maintenance half of the evidence. There is no borescope, which is the profile's hard requirement for a 3.4 M97, no DME over-rev report, and no cooling, AOS, water-pump or clutch records. Low annual use across four owners makes age-related items a real question rather than a non-issue. The asking price of $41,593 sits above the mileage-adjusted fair-value range of $30,190–$37,230, and the listing offers no documentation to support a premium. Inspection access in Wichita and CA emissions certification remain open.
evidence.next_action: Email Porsche Wichita asking for written permission to schedule an independent Porsche-specialist borescope and DME over-rev readout before any deposit, and request the intake inspection repair order, the full AutoCheck report, all service invoices and tire date-code photos in the same message.
